title: Training content fails to load
symptom: Several learners see a temporary error when opening one course.
affected_scope: Several learners in one customer account
recent_change: The customer reports an integration update earlier today.
customer_impact: A group of learners cannot complete the assigned course.

events.message: Upstream content dependency timed out after 3000 ms.

title: API request is rejected
symptom: A scheduled integration receives an unauthorized response.
recent_change: Credential rotation was planned this week; completion is unconfirmed.
customer_impact: The nightly user sync may be delayed.

events.message: Request received for the user-sync endpoint.
Authentication failed: token is expired or invalid; credential values redacted.

title: Dashboard data appears out of date
symptom: One administrator reports that today's activity is not visible yet.
recent_change: No recent change has been reported.
customer_impact: The administrator cannot confirm the latest learner activity.

events.message: Dashboard activity query completed with HTTP 200.

title: User sync hits a rate limit
symptom: A scheduled user sync pauses after repeated requests are throttled.
affected_scope: One customer integration during its nightly sync
recent_change: The integration schedule was changed this week.
customer_impact: Some user updates may not appear until the sync completes.

events.message: Request limit exceeded; retry-after guidance was returned.
